title: Ideal powers are the structure sheaf on the surjective-stalk open
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\iota:\mathcal I\hookrightarrow\mathcal O_X$ a monomorphism of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], with $\mathcal I$ quasi-coherent and of finite type [pqf-def-coherent]. Put $P_n=\mathcal I^n$ with inclusion $j_n:P_n\hookrightarrow\mathcal O_X$ and $P_0=\mathcal O_X$, using the recursive ideal powers of [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-module-product-stalk]. There is an open $U$ with $x\in U\Leftrightarrow\iota_x$ surjective, and for every $n\ge0$ and every open $W\subseteq U$, the section map $j_n(W):P_n(W)\to\mathcal O_X(W)$ is bijective.

source.place: Lemma 01PQ (lemma-sections-over-quasi-compact-open), proof; Lemma 01PM (lemma-sections-over-quasi-compact-open-in-affine), proof. Source text read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PQ and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PM.

proof.text: Define U as the union of opens W on which some ideal section maps to 1. Multiplying this section by arbitrary ring sections makes the inclusion locally surjective. Represent a stalk element on an open V, restrict to W intersect V, and take its germ to prove surjectivity at all points of U. Conversely, lift the germ of 1 at a surjective stalk, represent the lift locally and shrink the equality of germs; this gives membership in U.

source.place: Lemma 01PQ (lemma-sections-over-quasi-compact-open), proof; Lemma 01PM (lemma-sections-over-quasi-compact-open-in-affine), proof. Source text read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PQ and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PM.

proof.text: The recursive power inclusions are mono by induction, since the product inclusion is an image inclusion. Stalk injectivity follows from sectionwise injectivity. At a point of U, use ideal_module_product_stalk: the image ideal of the original stalk map is the unit ideal, so the range of every positive power stalk inclusion is its power, still the unit ideal. Degree zero is the identity. Compose with the structure-module stalk isomorphism to conclude surjectivity. Apply Mathlib TopCat.Presheaf.app_bijective_of_stalkFunctor_map_bijective to the associated abelian sheaf morphism on W.
